trust_decision.summary: Validating an untrusted label in check_label must take bounded (roughly linear) time; the CONTEXTJ check for U+200C scans the joining types of neighbouring characters, which became quadratic over a long label. At the pinned commit that scan already stops at the first character that is not type T.

landing_point.why: The summary names idna.encode; an engineer would start at encode -> alabel -> check_label -> valid_contextj.

fix_sites.entry_point: none (only the version string idna/package_data.py __version__ changes)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The CONTEXTO scans for U+30FB and Arabic-Indic digits belong to a different RFC 5892 rule family (CONTEXTO, not the joiner CONTEXTJ the advisory is about), and labels are 'limited to 63 octets' anyway.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid ZWNJ between joining letters with transparent (T) characters in between (e.g. Arabic/Persian labels), and the virama shortcut, must still be accepted; Katakana middle dot next to kana and Arabic-Indic digits that are not mixed must stay valid.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CONTEXTO U+30FB check scans the whole label once per middle dot, so it is quadratic in a label made of many U+30FB.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: This is the CONTEXTO rule, not the joiner context the fix optimized.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CONTEXTO Arabic-Indic / extended digit checks scan the whole label once per digit, so they are quadratic in a label of many such digits.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different rule (digit mixing); RTL labels are rare.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The label length (63) is checked only after check_label and punycode in alabel, so an arbitrarily long label reaches every per-label scan and the stdlib punycode.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Length is checked, just later; punycode is stdlib, not project code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The incremental encoder calls alabel per label with its own split; a planted copy of a joiner-context scan here would be a WHERE-type sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: codec.py already duplicates _unicode_dots_re and the label loop from core.encode.

O9_family: algorithmic complexity (quadratic validation loop) during IDNA label validation; CWE-1333 is nominal, there is no backtracking regex

O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_idna.py (contextj at tests/test_idna.py:92 and :165), tests/test_idna_codec.py, tests/test_idna_uts46.py

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject labels longer than 63 characters at the start of check_label/encode (breaks nothing much, but the fix is already present).

out_of_scope_notes: _unicode_dots_re at idna/core.py:10 and idna/codec.py:6 is a single character class; no ReDoS is possible, so the regex hint does not apply.
The stdlib 'punycode' codec (idna/core.py:43) is CPython code, outside this repository.
